milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smithing table is at spawn-relative position (1, 1, 9) inside the workshop. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they've found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from anywhere inside the workshop, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the table.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted brown mushroom is at spawn-relative position (1, 2, 9), sitting on top of the smithing table. The player must be near and facing it. Since it's directly above the smithing table, the player will naturally be close after finding the table. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the potted mushroom'.

Uses inventory_has because mining a block results in the dropped item appearing in inventory. Critical: oak_wall_sign blocks drop as 'oak_sign' items (not 'oak_wall_sign'). CommonSenseAgent confirmed this item ID distinction. The player breaks the sign on the back wall and picks up the oak_sign drop.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted item ends up in the player's inventory. The player must craft dark_oak_log → dark_oak_planks → dark_oak_button. The final product (dark_oak_button) appearing in inventory confirms successful completion of the full crafting chain. The player starts with no dark_oak_button, so min_count=1 is sufficient.
